mission: Build a fractal Google Maps of law for Swiss Federal Supreme Court case law from 2000 onward plus user-imported corpora, beating simple semantic-map baselines in legal usefulness.

corpus.question: Scale the canonical TF-2000+ acquisition/normalization pipeline from 1000 decisions to full coverage (2000-2024). Implement robust user corpus import with schema validation and map artifact persistence.

legal-distance.question: Using the frozen debiased_citation_blended baseline (n_pca=1, alpha=0.7) and validated fractal-map harness, run systematic UNSUPERVISED signal ablation: combine/weight legal-specific signals (sachverhalt TF-IDF, erwaegungen TF-IDF, norm/article embeddings, citation role weights, doctrine citations, outcome/holding) against the baseline to identify which legally structured signals improve nearest-neighbor legal relevance while suppressing procedural boilerplate. Leverage Jurivoc/TF metadata as evaluation proxies, not training labels.

fractal-map.question: Productize the multi-resolution hierarchical Leiden map for user-facing zoom/navigation: expose resolution ladder, cluster metadata, and legal coherence at each zoom level; validate that zoom reveals legally actionable substructure.

evaluation.question: Extend evaluation to v2: jurist usability studies, Jurivoc descriptor integration, scale benchmarks for full corpus, and adversarial tests for representation stability under corpus growth and cross-language transfer.

product.question: Complete the ugly-but-real vertical slice: persist user-imported map artifacts, add map export, integrate legal-distance signals as selectable map modes, and harden the corpus-to-map pipeline for TF base map plus user imports.

director_note: Evaluation lane v1 COMPLETE (14/14 benchmarks PASS on debiased_citation_blended n_pca=1 alpha=0.7; 1 marginal boilerplate failure is non-determinism artifact, fixed with global seed). Fractal-map lane validated: hierarchical Leiden nesting consistency 1.0, zoom coherence +7.1%, branch purity improves at finer resolutions (hierarchical_purity=0.9634). Product lane has 91-test vertical slice with evaluation integration, hierarchical Leiden as default. Corpus at 1000-decision slice + 250 yearly core; needs full TF 2000+ scale (2000-2024). Legal-distance lane was HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED (UNTESTED ≥5 cycles) — autonomously re-scoped to RUN with concrete unsupervised signal ablation plan leveraging: (1) frozen baseline, (2) complementary signal evidence from cycles 6/7 (sachverhalt→legal_area, erwaegungen→citation_proximity, language_debiased→citation_graph), (3) Jurivoc/TF metadata as evaluation proxies, (4) validated fractal-map harness. Frontier team frontier_metric_learning_jurivoc (RUN, charter v1) pursues SUPERVISED metric learning on same weak labels — independent complementary path. v2 shifts from validation to productization and legal-signal enrichment via dual-track (unsupervised ablation + supervised metric learning).
